en: Ahoy! I'm Briney. Once I sailed every day. These days I'd rather sit here with Peeko and watch the waves.
Hold still, Peeko! Why, it's {player}! You saved my darling Peeko. I owe you more than I can say.
You want to go to sea? A letter for Dewford and a parcel for Slateport, you say? My, you're a busy one!
Well, you've come to the right sailor. Shall we set sail for Dewford?
Mm? Not ready? Then come back whenever you are. The sea isn't going anywhere.
Ahoy, my friend! Shall we set sail for Dewford, then?
Just say the word whenever you want to cross the water.
Dewford it is! Anchors aweigh! Come along, Peeko, we're going to sea!
Ahoy! Here we are, Dewford Town! A tiny island, but a fine one.
You've a letter to deliver, haven't you? I'll wait here at the jetty. Off you go!
